column13: Older vintage (2010-2018); predates generative AI accelerator explosion
Forecasting rapid AI adoption entails significant uncertainty; utility filings heavily redacted
Relies partly on proprietary analyst tracking (SemiAnalysis, IDC) for AI hardware shipments
Theoretical TDP upper bound does not capture real-world operational power throttling
Indirect carbon/water estimations rely on company-wide averages rather than metered data
Relies on utility load forecasts subject to macroeconomic market shifts
Assumes fixed-price market capacity purchases up to 3 GW; unproven advanced nuclear reliance
Limited facility-level metered transparency; proprietary operator PUE confidentiality
Lack of validated dynamic simulation models for data centre loads in Indian grid studies
Applies prospectively to new applicants; does not retroactively restructure existing connections
National aggregate forecast (26.3 GW) without state-level or nodal disaggregation
Reports metered consumption only; does not capture behind-the-meter captive generation
